module.title: Kubernetes cluster checker
module.description: Check a Kubernetes cluster through its API server: cluster health, pods, nodes and workloads.
module.name: CheckKubernetes

commands.check_kubernetes: Check that the Kubernetes API server is reachable and ready: version, readiness and node counts.
commands.check_pods: Check the state of pods: phase, the kubectl STATUS column, readiness and restarts.
commands.check_nodes: Check node readiness, pressure conditions, schedulability and capacity.
